name: When should I consider converting existing space versus building a new addition for an in-law suite?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider converting existing space versus building a new addition for an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between converting existing space (like a garage or basement) or building a new addition for an in-law suite depends on several factors. Converting existing space is generally more cost-effective and quicker, as it utilizes existing foundations and structures. However, it might limit size and layout options. A new addition provides greater flexibility in design and amenities but comes with higher costs and a longer construction timeline. We can help assess your home's potential and your needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Convert existing space for cost-effectiveness and speed, or build an addition for greater design flexibility, depending on budget and needs.
